website.note: Confirms PM359 in Phase 1/2 (currently not enrolling new participants); CF, Wilson, AATD, CAR-T listed as preclinical/IND-enabling.

ctgov.note: 1 trial returned (PM359 NCT06559176, Phase 1/2, Enrolling by Invitation).

pipeline.modality: Ex vivo Prime Editing of autologous CD34+ hematopoietic stem cells (autologous HSCT)
pipeline.target: NCF1 gene (deltaGT mutation correction; restores p47phox / NADPH oxidase activity)

indications.indication: p47phox autosomal recessive chronic granulomatous disease (CGD)
indications.trial_design: Open-label single-arm Phase 1/2 in patients with p47phox autosomal recessive CGD undergoing autologous HSCT with PM359 Prime-Edited cells.
indications.trial_status: Enrolling by invitation (started Oct 2024; primary completion Jan 2030); positive early data published in NEJM; FDA discussions on accelerated approval path; BLA planned following final regulatory alignment
key_milestones: Initial clinical data: rapid and durable NADPH oxidase restoration
Planned BLA submission post regulatory alignment

excluded_preclinical.modality: In vivo LNP-delivered Prime Editor targeting ATP7B H1069Q
excluded_preclinical.status: Preclinical; IND/CTA planned 1H 2026; Phase 1/2 expected to start with initial data 2027

excluded_preclinical.asset: Follow-on Wilson editors (R778L and other ATP7B variants)

excluded_preclinical.modality: Prime Editing via LNP and AAV (incl. PASSIGE platform)
